subject: Acme Health - SOC 2 post-call recap & evidence next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Health - SOC 2 post-call recap & evidence next steps

Hi Laura / Acme security team,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — appreciated the candid discussion about your compliance requirements and timeline. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of pain points / goals we heard:
- SOC 2 Type 2 report is required before procurement sign-off (target: Q3 renewal window).
- Audit logs & retention: you need 1 year of immutable audit logs for read/write operations and a longer retention policy for exports.
- Data residency & DPA: require an updated DPA with explicit language about log retention, subprocessors, and encryption-at-rest.
- Pen test evidence: high-level summary and remediation timeline for any critical findings and the latest penetration test report.

What we (Redwood) will provide (next 48–72 hours):
- SOC 2 Type 2 (redacted) PDF and summary that maps to your control families.
- Pen test executive summary (redacted) + remediation status.
- Draft DPA with our standard security appendix and a tracked-redlines copy for your legal team.
- Short technical note describing audit-log schema, retention options, and how to configure export/webhooks for long-term storage.

Immediate ask for you: please confirm the list of recipients for the evidence bundle and whether priority items (SOC2 and DPA) should go to legal@acmehealth.com in addition to security@acmehealth.com.

Tentative timeline:
- 2027-06-03: deliver evidence bundle to your security/legal inboxes.
- 2027-06-10: follow-up call to walk through any redlines or clarifying questions (we can book a 30-min slot).

If that works, we’ll send the docs and a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: (will deliver in follow-up)

---
Note: internal: Neha / Rishi — I flagged the SOC2/pen test & DPA requests in the deal. Can you confirm we have redacted versions ready and whether legal should expect any non-standard DPA terms?

From: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com, legal@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Health - SOC 2 post-call recap & evidence next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. Confirming the recipients: please send the evidence bundle to security@acmehealth.com and legal@acmehealth.com.

A few clarifications / asks from our side:
1) SOC 2: we need a redacted Type 2 for the period covering 2025. If you have a controls mapping document (which shows where your controls map to our requirements) that would be helpful.
2) Audit logs: we need confirmation that audit logs include actor, action, timestamp, resource, and originating IP, and that logs are retained for at least 365 days in an immutable store. Also need to understand export options (S3, GCS) and whether logs can be forwarded to our SIEM.
3) DPA: our legal team will upload redlines but please include a tracked-change Word version for easier review.
4) Pen test: we only need an executive summary with remediation status for any critical/high findings; full report can be redacted.

If you can deliver the SOC2 + DPA tracked redlines by Thu 6/3 that would allow our internal review before the end of next week. Looking forward to the follow-up call — I’ll send some times.

Best,
Laura
Head of InfoSec, Acme Health
---

- SOC 2 Type 2 (2025) redacted PDF is ready. It removes customer-identifiable info and the test data sections.
- Pen test: we have a redacted executive summary (Redacted_PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf) that lists the critical/high findings and current remediation status.
- DPA: legal prepared a tracked Word doc with our standard security appendix; I attached the tracked redlines (redlines_acme_dpa_v1.docx).
- Audit logs: I've drafted a short technical note (audit_logs_and_retention.txt) that details fields, retention defaults, and export endpoints (S3/GCS) + steps for SIEM forwarding.

I can push the bundle to the Drive folder and share links to security@acmehealth.com and legal@acmehealth.com by EOD PT tomorrow (2027-06-03). If Laura confirms the target recipients, I’ll proceed.

Also tagging Rishi on the DPA questions around subprocessors (Rishi — can you confirm whether we need to add the new GPU infra provider to the subprocessors list or if it’s covered by the existing appendix?).

Thanks,
Neha

Redwood Inference
